title: StrataSLAM: open multi-floor 3D SLAM for ROS 2
description: Open multi-floor 3D SLAM for ROS 2: one point cloud per floor and a global one, without floors collapsing into each other. RGB-D camera, 3D LiDAR or both, with IMU, barometer and external odometry. One YAML profile, a setup checker (strataslam doctor) and offline floor fusion in SE(2)xR.
